blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The House prosecution is confident that its evidence can secure the conviction of Vice President Sara Duterte in her impeachment trial, rather than relying on a lower voting threshold, former Rep. Robert Ace Barbers, House prosecution adviser and spokesperson, said Wednesday. Barbers stressed that point during a post-trial news briefing after being asked about Senator-Judge Imee Marcos’ argument during the proceedings that the “finish line” should not be moved simply because the race had become difficult to finish. “Right from the start of this trial, we have never relied on numbers,” Barbers said in Filipino. “That can be […]...
